# Requirements

Make the VS Code Agent view a responsive, transparent ACP client where Codex and Claude Code can use Codify's MCP server naturally and users can follow every turn.

## Requirement 1: Natural ACP sessions

**User Story:** As a developer, I want Codex and Claude Code sessions to expose their native ACP controls and state so that the editor feels like a first-class client instead of a thin prompt box.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. WHEN an ACP session starts THE extension SHALL advertise the client capabilities it actually serves and inject the workspace-scoped Codify MCP server into session/new.
2. WHEN the agent reports modes, configuration, commands, session information, or usage THE panel SHALL surface the update and allow supported mode and configuration changes through ACP.
3. WHEN an agent command is advertised THE composer SHALL make it discoverable without shadowing Codify's local slash commands and SHALL send it to the agent as a normal prompt.

## Requirement 2: Readable, responsive conversation

**User Story:** As a developer, I want streamed work to remain readable at sidebar and editor widths so that I always know what the agent is doing and what needs my attention.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. WHEN the agent streams Markdown THE panel SHALL render headings, emphasis, links, lists, task lists, tables, quotes, and fenced code safely while preserving one stable message during streaming.
2. WHEN tools, plans, permissions, queued prompts, or turn state change THE panel SHALL present a concise live activity summary plus detailed expandable evidence.
3. WHEN the view becomes narrow or wide THE header, transcript, tool cards, and composer SHALL reflow without clipped controls or horizontal page scrolling.

## Requirement 3: Grounded integration

**User Story:** As a maintainer, I want the richer client behavior covered by dependency-free tests and accurate docs so that ACP adapter changes do not silently degrade the chat.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. WHEN the ACP fixture emits every supported session update THE integration tests SHALL prove the extension-to-panel mapping and user control round trips.
2. WHEN the panel renders representative Markdown and activity THE headless DOM tests SHALL prove the visible state, responsive hooks, and command routing.
3. WHEN the feature ships THE extension documentation and changelog SHALL describe the user-visible ACP, MCP, Markdown, and activity behavior.

## Requirement 4: Session continuity

**User Story:** As a developer, I want to find and reopen earlier agent sessions so that a reload or new chat does not make ongoing work disappear.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. WHEN the Agent view opens THE panel SHALL offer a past-session selector populated from workspace history and ACP session/list when the adapter supports it.
2. WHEN a past session is selected THE extension SHALL restore it with session/load, or session/resume when full replay is unavailable, while reinjecting the workspace Codify MCP server.
3. WHEN the adapter cannot list or restore sessions THE selector SHALL degrade honestly and preserve locally known metadata without claiming that history was loaded.

## Requirement 5: Visible installed build

**User Story:** As a developer installing a VSIX, I want to see which Codify build is active so that reload and packaging failures are immediately obvious.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. WHEN the Agent view initializes THE panel SHALL display the running extension version from its own installed manifest.
2. WHEN the current Codify extension is packaged THE manifest SHALL use the authoritative Marketplace identity SidioraLabs.codify and the VSIX SHALL contain the current ACP controller and panel payloads.
